title: Finance Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – FINANCE MANAGER

**Position:** Finance Manager  
**Department:** Finance & Accounts  
**Reports To:** Management / Director  
**Location:** Madurai, Tamil Nadu

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and responsible **Finance Manager** to manage the company’s financial operations, accounting activities, cash flow, budgeting, statutory compliance, and financial reporting. The candidate should ensure accurate financial records and provide timely financial insights to management for effective decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage day-to-day accounting and finance operations.
* Prepare and monitor **budgets, cash flow statements, and financial forecasts**.
* Maintain accurate records of income, expenses, receivables, and payables.
* Monitor **project-wise income and expenses**, particularly for construction and interior projects.
* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.
* Monitor customer collections and outstanding payments.
* Manage vendor payments and payment schedules.
* Ensure timely **GST, TDS, income tax, and other statutory compliance**.
* Coordinate with auditors, tax consultants, banks, and other financial institutions.
* Review bank statements and perform regular bank reconciliations.
* Monitor company expenses and identify opportunities for cost control.
* Establish and maintain proper financial controls and accounting procedures.
* Verify invoices, purchase bills, expense claims, and payment requests.
* Support payroll processing and employee-related financial matters.
* Provide management with financial analysis and recommendations.
* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax regulations, and company policies.
* Maintain confidentiality of all financial and business information.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in **Commerce, Finance, Accounting, or a related field**.
* CA / CMA / MBA Finance qualification will be an added advantage.
* **5+ years of relevant experience** in finance and accounting.
* Experience in the **construction, real estate, or interiors industry** will be preferred.
* Strong knowledge of **GST, TDS, taxation, accounting, and financial reporting**.
* Good working knowledge of **Tally / accounting software and MS Excel**.

Key Skills

* Financial planning & analysis
* Budgeting and cash-flow management
* Accounting & taxation
* GST & TDS compliance
* Project cost monitoring
* Accounts receivable & payable
* Bank reconciliation
* Team management
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Attention to detail and accuracy
* Good communication and leadership skills

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely and accurate financial reporting
* Effective cash-flow management
* Timely statutory compliance
* Reduction in outstanding receivables
* Effective project cost control
* Accurate accounting and reconciliation
* Timely vendor payments
* Improved financial controls and cost efficiency

Preferred Candidate

The ideal candidate should be **responsible, analytical, detail-oriented, and capable of independently handling the company’s finance and accounts function**, while providing clear financial information to management.

Contact us : 73050 65791

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
